abilities.title: Shadowfax
abilities.text: Gandalf may move up to 4 regions when moving alone or with exactly one Hobbit. With a larger group, use normal Companion movement. His level remains 3 for other purposes.
abilities.sourceDocument: BASE · Gandalf the White 8/11 (Second Edition); T20

abilities.title: The White Rider
abilities.text: At the start of a battle, after any Stronghold shelter decision and before Combat cards, you may forfeit Gandalf’s Leadership to cancel the Leadership of all Nazgûl, including the Witch-king, for the entire battle. Their presence and other abilities are unchanged.
abilities.sourceDocument: BASE · Gandalf the White 8/11 (Second Edition); T20

abilities.title: Captain of the West
abilities.text: While participating in a battle, add 1 to the Combat Strength of the Free Peoples army, up to the limit of 5 Combat dice.

abilities.title: Guide
abilities.text: Gollum joins the Fellowship and becomes its Guide when no Companions remain. He is not a Companion.

abilities.title: Guide · Unseen path
abilities.text: While Gollum is Guide, ignore the Reveal symbol on standard numbered Hunt tiles. Eye tiles and special Hunt tiles retain their normal effects.

abilities.title: Guide · Reveal
abilities.text: If the Fellowship is hidden and is not already required to reveal, you may reveal it in a legal destination to reduce Hunt damage by 1, to a minimum of 0. The usual restrictions on revealing the Fellowship still apply. This cannot reduce damage that must be taken entirely as Corruption.

abilities.title: Master of the Precious
abilities.text: When all Companions have left the Fellowship or been eliminated, add Gollum as its Guide.

abilities.title: Bound to Orthanc
abilities.text: Saruman cannot leave Orthanc, including with an army, during retreat or when advancing after combat. He may still lead an attack from Orthanc.

abilities.title: The Voice of Saruman
abilities.text: While Saruman is in Shadow-controlled Orthanc and is not under siege, spend a Muster die to recruit one Isengard Regular in each available unconquered Isengard Settlement, or replace two Isengard Regulars in Orthanc with Elites. Use available reserves and follow normal recruitment and stacking restrictions; a shortage permits only the replacements possible.

abilities.title: Servants of the White Hand
abilities.text: While Saruman is in play, every Isengard Elite also counts as a Leader for movement and combat. It remains a single army unit.

cards.source: BASE · The Mouth of Sauron 2/3 (Second Edition); T20

abilities.title: Messenger of the Dark Tower
abilities.text: Once per turn, you may use a Muster die as an Army die: move up to two armies, make an attack or play an Army Event card. Spend the selected die as the cost of that action.
abilities.source: BASE · The Mouth of Sauron 2/3 (Second Edition)
abilities.sourceDocument: BASE · The Mouth of Sauron 2/3 (Second Edition); T20

abilities.title: Terror on entering play
abilities.text: When the Witch-king enters play, activate all Free Peoples Nations.

abilities.title: Sorcerer
abilities.text: After the first combat round resolves, if the Witch-king is still participating and you played a Combat card in that round, you may draw one card from the matching deck. A cancelled Combat card still counts as played. Finish any round continuation or retreat decisions before drawing.

abilities.title: Vilya
abilities.text: After a paid action fully resolves, you may give the Vilya Ring to the Shadow to keep the just-used Action die and its result available. You cannot keep a Will of the West result. A die used to move the Fellowship does not enter the Hunt box when kept this way. Elrond must still be in play.

abilities.title: Household of Elrond
abilities.text: Elven Elites in Elrond’s region also count as Leaders for all combat purposes. This does not grant Leadership for movement; an Elite downgraded to a Regular immediately loses the benefit.

abilities.title: Combat-card level
abilities.text: Treat Elrond as level 3 when resolving Combat card effects. His normal level remains 0.

abilities.title: Bound to Rivendell
abilities.text: Elrond cannot leave Rivendell, even with an army. Remove him from play if the Shadow conquers Rivendell.

abilities.title: Nenya
abilities.text: Immediately after drawing a standard Eye Hunt tile, you may give the Nenya Ring to the Shadow to cancel the tile, remove it for the rest of the game and draw a replacement. This does not cancel a numbered tile or a special Eye tile.

abilities.title: Valour of the Elven People
abilities.text: You may recruit in Lórien while it is under siege. The usual recruitment costs, political requirements, reserves and stacking limits still apply; this does not allow recruitment after the Shadow conquers Lórien.

abilities.title: Combat-card level
abilities.text: Treat Galadriel as level 3 when resolving Combat card effects. Her normal level remains 0.

abilities.title: Bound to Lórien
abilities.text: Galadriel cannot leave Lórien, even with an army. Remove her from play if the Shadow conquers Lórien.

abilities.title: Narya
abilities.text: While Gandalf is outside the Fellowship in an unconquered Free Peoples Settlement, give the Narya Ring to the Shadow and spend any available Action die to activate that Settlement’s Nation and move its Political counter directly to At War.

abilities.title: Guide · Narya die
abilities.text: Add the Narya die at Recover only if Gandalf is Guide and at least one Free Peoples movement die is recovered from the Hunt box. A Keeper Eye alone does not qualify. If he starts the game as Guide, add Narya in turn 1; choosing him later in the Fellowship phase does not add it that turn.

abilities.title: Emissary from the West
abilities.text: Outside the Fellowship, or after being eliminated, Gandalf the Grey may become Gandalf the White by spending a Will of the West die once a Minion other than the Balrog, Gothmog, the Witch-king — Chief of the Ringwraiths, or any Dark Chieftain has entered play. Replace a surviving Grey in his region; otherwise enter in Fangorn or an unconquered Elven Stronghold, even under siege.
abilities.source: LORDS · LM 3/10; pp. 19–20; LORDS p. 6; KINGS p. 14

abilities.title: Guide
abilities.text: The first Sméagol tile adds Sméagol as the mandatory Guide if Gollum has never entered play and Sméagol has not previously been removed. That tile, and later Sméagol tiles drawn while he is present, cause no damage and are permanently removed. This effect occurs before Mithril Coat and Sting can cancel the tile.

abilities.title: Level X
abilities.text: Sméagol’s level equals the highest level of another Companion in the Fellowship. He counts as a Companion for Hunt allocation and may be chosen as a Hunt casualty. He never becomes an army character, has no Leadership and does not count as Gollum for card effects.

abilities.title: Departure
abilities.text: Remove Sméagol if he separates, is eliminated, or the Fellowship declares in an unconquered Free Peoples City or Stronghold. Place We Shall Get It on the table; if he becomes the only Companion, he instead leaves immediately and is replaced by Gollum without placing the event. Forced Reveal alone does not trigger departure. Sméagol cannot return; discard and redraw any later Sméagol tile.
abilities.source: LORDS · LM 4/10; pp. 21–22; LORDS FAQ 1.2 p. 3
abilities.sourceDocument: LORDS · LM 4/10; pp. 21–22; T25; LORDS FAQ 1.2 p. 3

abilities.title: Fire and Shadow
abilities.text: After the Fellowship declares or reveals along a route entering, leaving, passing through or remaining in the Balrog’s region, draw an additional Hunt tile before any Stronghold Hunt tile and ignore its Reveal effect. An Eye eliminates the Balrog and the Guide; if Gollum is Guide, discard that Eye instead and eliminate neither.

abilities.title: Flame of Udûn
abilities.text: While participating in a battle, the Balrog adds 2 to the Combat Strength of the Shadow army, up to the limit of 5 Combat dice.

abilities.title: Activation
abilities.text: A Use Balrog result or A Balrog is Come! activates him, raising his level from 0 to 2 without moving him. When already active, Use Balrog permits one army move, one army attack or movement of the Balrog alone. Free Peoples may deactivate him with Will of the West, or with Character if Gandalf is in his region: in Moria he becomes inactive; elsewhere he is eliminated.

abilities.title: Gandalf the White entry
abilities.text: This character does not count as a Minion for the condition that allows Gandalf the White to enter play.

abilities.title: Fling Them into the Fray
abilities.text: While Gothmog is with a Shadow army in a free region, spend a Muster die to recruit one Sauron Regular or replace one Sauron Regular there with an Elite, using available reserves. The region may contain a Stronghold besieged by his army, but Gothmog cannot use this ability while his own army is under siege.

abilities.title: Gandalf the White entry

abilities.title: Evil Knowledge
abilities.text: When the Mouth is with a besieging army, you may extend a siege assault by one round without reducing an Elite to a Regular. Use this at most once during the entire action; further rounds require the normal cost.

abilities.title: Great Sorcery
abilities.text: Once per turn, while the Mouth is with a Shadow army, you may use a Muster die as a Character die to move or attack with that specific army. It cannot pay for an Event card or an action by another army.

abilities.title: Spear of Terror
abilities.text: When the Witch-king is in the Fellowship’s region and you play a Shadow Character Event, you may immediately draw a Character Event card, before resolving the played event. With The Palantír of Orthanc, draw at most one card in total; declining this immediate draw leaves the Palantír’s later draw available.

abilities.title: He Sees, He Knows
abilities.text: After the Fellowship declares in a region without an unconquered Free Peoples Stronghold, you may immediately move the Witch-king to that region without spending an action. A forced Reveal does not trigger this ability.

abilities.title: Elvenking
abilities.text: When the Elves are At War and Thranduil is in Woodland Realm, spend a Muster result to replace one Elven Regular in his army with an Elite. This works during a siege. Return the Regular to reserves; an Elite must be available.
abilities.sourceDocument: docs/sources/kings-character-index.json (kings.character.thranduil.awakened), card front KM 9/10; KINGS pp. 7,8,9,10,11,12,13

abilities.title: Far-sighted
abilities.text: While the Fellowship is off the Mordor Track, spend a Ruler Character result or Will of the West. Choose one: move the Fellowship with one fewer Hunt die, to a minimum of one; or move or separate Companions with one extra region of range. Normal route restrictions apply. This does not change Hunt success numbers or re-rolls.
abilities.sourceDocument: docs/sources/kings-character-index.json (kings.character.thranduil.awakened), card front KM 9/10; KINGS pp. 7,8,9,10,11,12,13

cards.source: docs/sources/kings-character-index.json (kings.character.thranduil.corrupted), card front KM 10/10; KINGS pp. 7,8,9,10,11,12,13

abilities.title: Corrupted ruler
abilities.text: Elites cannot be recruited in Woodland Realm, except by Event effects; Leaders remain allowed. Corrupted Thranduil cannot move, awaken or participate in battle, and does not die with an army. A Companion with the Elves or Free Peoples icon in his region may remove him by spending a Character result; removal ends both weaknesses.
abilities.sourceDocument: docs/sources/kings-character-index.json (kings.character.thranduil.corrupted), card front KM 10/10; KINGS pp. 7,8,9,10,11,12,13

abilities.title: Fate of Mirkwood
abilities.text: Once per siege battle at Woodland Realm, Shadow may extend its assault for one more round by eliminating one participating Shadow Regular instead of reducing an Elite. Other assault requirements still apply.
abilities.sourceDocument: docs/sources/kings-character-index.json (kings.character.thranduil.corrupted), card front KM 10/10; KINGS pp. 7,8,9,10,11,12,13

cards.source: docs/sources/kings-character-index.json (kings.character.black-serpent), card front KM 1/3; KINGS pp. 7,14,15

abilities.title: Red Wrath
abilities.text: When the Black Serpent participates in battle, before revealing cards you may replace your legal Combat card effect and suffer one hit on your army. At initiative 3, add 1 to all Shadow Combat rolls this round, or 2 if the replaced card is Relentless Assault. This does not modify Leader re-rolls. Your card still counts as played; cancelling the replacement does not refund the hit.
abilities.sourceDocument: docs/sources/kings-character-index.json (kings.character.black-serpent), card front KM 1/3; KINGS pp. 7,14,15

abilities.title: Dark Chieftain
abilities.text: This character is a Minion for normal rules and effects, but its entry does not fulfil Gandalf the White’s Minion requirement. It moves by non-flying Minion routes, respecting impassable borders and stronghold restrictions. A living Dark Chieftain provides the shared Shadow Ruler die at Recover, not an immediate extra die.
abilities.sourceDocument: docs/sources/kings-character-index.json (kings.character.black-serpent), card front KM 1/3; KINGS pp. 7,14,15

abilities.title: Lord of the Bats
abilities.text: When the Shadow of Mirkwood participates in battle, before revealing cards you may replace your legal Combat card effect and forfeit this character’s Leadership. At initiative 4, add 1 to all Shadow Leader re-rolls this round. If the replaced card is Swarm of Bats, also cancel the Free Peoples card effect at initiative 0. Remaining Leadership is still required for re-rolls; your card still counts as played.
abilities.sourceDocument: docs/sources/kings-character-index.json (kings.character.shadow-of-mirkwood), card front KM 2/3; KINGS pp. 7,14,15

abilities.title: I Command
abilities.text: When Uglúk participates in battle, before revealing cards you may replace your legal Combat card effect. At initiative 3, add 1 to both armies’ Combat rolls and Leader re-rolls this round. If the replaced card is Desperate Battle, only Shadow receives the bonus. Your card still counts as played and the replacement can be cancelled normally.
abilities.sourceDocument: docs/sources/kings-character-index.json (kings.character.ugluk), card front KM 3/3; KINGS pp. 7,14,15

abilities.title: We March Day and Night
abilities.text: When Uglúk is in the Fellowship’s region or an adjacent region, add 1 to every Shadow Hunt re-roll die. This also works while the Fellowship is hidden. It does not grant a re-roll or modify the initial Hunt roll.
abilities.sourceDocument: docs/sources/kings-character-index.json (kings.character.ugluk), card front KM 3/3; KINGS pp. 7,14,15

abilities.title: Captain of the West
abilities.text: When Gimli participates in a battle, increase his Free Peoples army’s Combat Strength by 1. The Combat roll is still limited to five dice. This is not extra Leadership or a bonus to die results.
abilities.source: FATE Collector’s Edition pp.45–46; WOTR018 rules, Lords paragraph; LORDS pp.30–31 and FAQ 1.2 p.3 · 1/11 FE

abilities.title: Dwarf of Renown
abilities.text: In Iron Hills or Ered Luin, spend any available Action die result to advance the Dwarves one step on the Political Track. This does not activate the nation and normal political limits still apply. The region need not be unconquered; Erebor does not qualify.
abilities.source: FATE Collector’s Edition pp.45–46; WOTR018 rules, Lords paragraph; LORDS pp.30–31 and FAQ 1.2 p.3 · 1/11 FE

abilities.title: Guide
abilities.text: During a Hunt, you may separate Gimli while he is the Guide to reduce Hunt damage by 1, to a minimum of zero. This may be used at zero damage, but not against damage that must be taken entirely as Corruption. Companions separated against the same tile form one group; changing the Guide is a separate decision.
abilities.source: FATE Collector’s Edition pp.45–46; WOTR018 rules, Lords paragraph; LORDS pp.30–31 and FAQ 1.2 p.3 · LM 6/10 FE

abilities.title: Dwarven Champion
abilities.text: When Gimli participates in a battle whose defending army is in a Dwarven region, add 1 to the Free Peoples army’s Combat Strength, still limited to five Combat dice. This works whether Free Peoples attacks or defends. Use the current Fate board: Erebor belongs to Sauron and does not qualify.
abilities.source: FATE Collector’s Edition pp.45–46; WOTR018 rules, Lords paragraph; LORDS pp.30–31 and FAQ 1.2 p.3 · LM 6/10 FE

abilities.title: Messenger of Elrond
abilities.text: In Iron Hills or Ered Luin, spend any available Action die result to activate the Dwarves and advance them one step on the Political Track. The region need not be unconquered; Erebor does not qualify. This ability does not give Gimli a Dwarven nation icon.
abilities.source: FATE Collector’s Edition pp.45–46; WOTR018 rules, Lords paragraph; LORDS pp.30–31 and FAQ 1.2 p.3 · LM 6/10 FE

abilities.title: Movement level
abilities.text: Treat Gimli’s Level as 2 only for movement. His printed Level remains 1 for Hunt casualties and Combat card effects. This version has no nation icon. With Council, its starting homelands are Iron Hills or Ered Luin, not Erebor.
abilities.source: FATE Collector’s Edition pp.45–46; WOTR018 rules, Lords paragraph; LORDS pp.30–31 and FAQ 1.2 p.3 · LM 6/10 FE
